content.value_statement: Teams can struggle to choose which creator assets deserve paid spend and how to reuse them across channels. This skill creates a structured amplification or repurposing plan from approved assets and user-provided data.
actual_capabilities: Scores approved creator content for paid amplification using performance, hook, message, quality, and CTA criteria.
Creates budget allocations by content, campaign objective, platform, and amplification method.
Builds audience targeting, testing, optimization, scale, pause, and creative-refresh guidance.
Maps approved source assets into platform-specific video, static, website, email, and social formats.
Produces a rights-tracked content inventory, asset naming convention, and 30-day distribution plan.
limitations: Does not verify FTC disclosures, claim accuracy, brand alignment, or whether content is publishable.
Requires the user to provide campaign metrics, budget, source assets, and usage-rights information.
Does not connect to advertising, analytics, CRM, influencer, or asset-management platforms by itself.
Provides planning guidance and does not launch campaigns, edit assets, or obtain creator authorization.

use_cases.title: Allocate an influencer ad budget
use_cases.description: Rank approved creator posts and assign a paid budget across platforms, objectives, and amplification methods.

use_cases.title: Extend UGC across channels
use_cases.description: Turn approved videos and reviews into a rights-aware plan for paid ads, product pages, email, and organic social.

use_cases.title: Organize a creator asset library
use_cases.description: Create an inventory, naming convention, rights tracker, and distribution calendar for existing creator content.

prompt_templates.title: Choose content to boost
prompt_templates.prompt: We have five approved creator posts. Help me rank them for paid amplification. Ask me for views, engagement rate, budget, platforms, and campaign objective.

prompt_templates.title: Build a paid media plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a paid amplification plan for approved TikTok and Instagram creator content. Our budget is $5,000 and our goal is traffic. Include content scoring, audience targeting, budget allocation, and scale or pause rules.

prompt_templates.title: Repurpose approved UGC
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a rights-aware repurposing plan for three approved creator videos. Map each video into paid, website, email, and organic social formats, then provide a 30-day distribution calendar.

prompt_templates.title: Create an optimization playbook
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the following user-provided campaign results, create a testing and optimization playbook. Label all missing metrics as estimated or request the required export. Include KPI targets, decision thresholds, and a creative-refresh plan.

output_examples.input: Five approved creator videos, a $5,000 budget, and a traffic objective.
output: A ranked scorecard identifies three videos for amplification.
The budget is split by creator, platform, and objective and totals $5,000.
The plan includes audience segments and scale, pause, and refresh thresholds.

output_examples.input: Three approved creator videos with rights for paid, website, email, and social use.
output: A content inventory records each asset, creator, rights level, and expiration date.
A repurposing map converts the strongest video into short ads, stills, a website embed, and email assets.
A dated 30-day distribution plan lists each channel and required asset.

best_practices: Confirm usage rights and expiration dates before recommending reuse on paid, website, or email channels.
Provide actual campaign metrics and label estimates clearly when reliable data is unavailable.
Start with a stated budget and campaign objective so allocations and optimization rules are actionable.
anti_patterns: Do not reuse creator content when usage rights are unknown or restricted.
Do not present estimated CPM, ROAS, reach, or rights dates as measured values.
Do not use this skill as a substitute for disclosure, claim, or brand-safety review.

faq.question: What content can this skill amplify?
faq.answer: It plans amplification for creator content that is already approved and cleared for the intended use.

faq.question: Can it create Spark Ads or Partnership Ads?
faq.answer: It provides planning and setup guidance. It does not access platforms or obtain creator authorization.

faq.question: What information should I provide for paid mode?
faq.answer: Provide creator assets, performance metrics, budget, objective, target platforms, and any prior campaign results.

faq.question: What information should I provide for repurpose mode?
faq.answer: Provide source assets, creator and platform details, usage rights, performance data, and target channels.

faq.question: Does it verify rights or FTC compliance?
faq.answer: No. It records the rights information you provide and directs compliance review to a dedicated auditor.

faq.question: Can it use live advertising data?
faq.answer: No live connection is required or included. You can provide exported metrics for the plan to use.
